title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.

desc: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.

desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.
